newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Fr.Telecom group gets Romania GSM licence.
newsitem.headline: Fr.Telecom group gets Romania GSM licence.

text.p: Romania's Communications Ministry on Thursday granted the MobilRom consortium led by France Telecom a licence it won last month in a tender for a digital GSM system.
Last month, the ministry said MobilRom and a consortium named MobiFon, led by AirTouch Communications Inc of the U.S., had won the two licences offered in the bid.

But the bluTel and Zephir consortia, led by Stet Spa of Italy and by Motorola Inc of the U.S., challenged the way the Monaco-based La Compagnie de Conseil was appointed by the Communications ministry to review the offers submitted in the tender. It asked for the results to be reconsidered.
The commission had "compromised the objectivity of a neutral consultant" as it allegedly had been involved in joint business projects with France Telecom, the two consortia said.
Last month Zephir launched a lawsuit asking for an independent review of the underlying evaluation procedures. A court hearing in the case is expected next week.

MobilRom groups Alcatel Network Systems Romania, a branch of Alcatel, Romanian private computer retailer ComputerLand and the MediaPro media group. Tomen Telecom Romania a subsidiary of Tomen Corp, is also part of the group. -- Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
